newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria Airlines sees better results in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Austria Airlines sees better results in 1997.

text.p: Austrian Airlines AG (AUA) said on Thursday it expected to improve its results significantly in 1997 from last year.
"We want to raise profit before tax to 300 million schillings," AUA chief executive Mario Rehulka told Reuters, reiterating earlier comments.

The company said pre-tax profit in 1996 would be around 55.1 milllion schillings. Its original target of 300 million schillings for 1996 had to be revised due to lower than expected growth in passenger traffic and an increase in fuel costs.
